name: Senior move manager

pf.license.need: no state license to plan, sort, pack or set up a home in most places, only a business registration; a household goods mover's license (and the state's mover rules) only where the business itself carries belongings in its own truck for pay; otherwise the move is done by a licensed moving company the family hires
ask: A mover's license, only if the business itself moves goods
General liability insurance, and a bond or crime coverage for staff working in clients' homes
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.credentials: A senior move manager association membership and certificates are the business's own word, shown that way, never as a license
blocks: Planning, sorting, packing and unpacking go live on identity and registration
Moving goods in the business's own truck goes live only with the mover's license, where the state's rules require one
pf.license.background: A criminal background check for every person who works in a client's home (the business's own rule, shown to the customer as checked)
pf.license.renewals: Insurance and any mover's license reminded 30 days before they lapse; a lapse pauses that part of the work

pf.services.shape: Project: a free in-home assessment with the older adult and the family, then a written plan and estimate, then a series of sessions (sorting, packing, move day, unpacking) over weeks, billed by the hour every Friday
pf.services.examples: the example business's own prices, not a standard

B.name: In-home assessment
B.where: at the older adult's home; the older adult is there and takes part, and family may join in person or by phone
B.after: nothing owed; the written plan and estimate follow within 3 business days

B.price: $85 an hour per person, estimated 40 to 60 person-hours (example): $3,400 to $5,100; the rate and range are set in the signed agreement
B.where: at the old home and the new home
B.before: nothing taken at the assessment; a $500 retainer when the agreement is signed (example), taken off the last bill
B.after: billed every Friday for the hours worked that week, with each session's start and end times
B.note: the moving company is hired separately by the family and paid its own way; the business books and supervises the date

B.name: Downsizing and sorting session
B.note: for an older adult staying put who wants less in the home

B.name: Home setup visit (unpacking and setting up the new home)
B.where: at the new home (an apartment, assisted living or a family member's home)
B.note: the bed made, clothes put away, pictures hung, the kitchen set up the way it was

B.name: Floor plan visit
B.price: $275: measured at the new home, a drawn plan after (example)

B.name: Room-by-room plan from photos
B.where: by photos; for families who live far away

B.name: Phone check-in
B.price: free: 10 minutes by phone with the lead before the assessment

B.name: Labor

B.where: added to a session, never booked alone

B.name: Change order
B.price: priced, written and signed by the payer before the changed work

A.name: Planning session

A.name: Mover quote review

A.name: Planning package (plan, floor plan sheet, mover quote review)
Plan from photos

pf.services.capacity: Two people for packing and move days; one for sorting sessions; the same lead for the whole move where possible
pf.services.online: Planning calls and the remote move plan by phone or video; no hands-on work online
pf.services.nobody_home: Unpacking at the new home before the older adult arrives, and packing days the family OKs, may be done with nobody home (a start photo and DONE with photos); the assessment and sorting sessions need the older adult there

before_times: Who is moving, and who is asking (the older adult, a family member, a care manager)?
Where from and where to: the town or ZIP of each (a house, an apartment, assisted living, a family member's home)
Any date the move must happen by: a move-in date set by the community, a closing or a lease end
What help is needed: the whole move, sorting only, or setting up the new home
after_time: Who will be at the assessment, and who decides what goes and what stays?
Anything that helps the visit go well: hearing, sight, walking, the best time of day
Pets, and who will care for them on move day
The new home's rules: move-in hours, an elevator to book, an insurance certificate
secure_page_only: Both street addresses and how to get in
The older adult's own contact, and how they like to be reached (text, a call to a landline, or only through the family)
Who has a power of attorney or guardianship, if anyone, and who signs and pays
Health or memory details that change how sessions run (only on this page, only for the lead)
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult. The older adult agrees to the move and to the sessions themself whenever they can. A family member may book and pay for them. Where the older adult can't decide, an agent under a power of attorney or a guardian signs the agreement. The business never books a move the older adult says they don't want.
planning: Who is moving, and who is asking?
The new home's floor plan or its size, if the family has it

stop.words: the older adult has fallen and can't get up, is suddenly confused, has chest pain or trouble breathing
a fire, smoke or a gas smell
stop.says: Leave the home now, and call 911.

steps_then_go_on.says: Sessions are short and at the best time of day, the same person comes each time, and a family member is on call.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on; the details stay on the secure page

steps_then_go_on.words: the older adult is being pressured, neglected or has money taken by someone
steps_then_go_on.says: A hotline is given. The owner is told privately the same day; the business follows its own reporting steps where the state's rules require them. Rosie gives no advice.

steps_then_go_on.words: oxygen in the home, a fall risk, a walker or wheelchair
steps_then_go_on.says: Paths are kept clear during sessions. Oxygen tanks are never packed in a moving truck.

steps_then_go_on.words: hoarding, pests or a home that isn't safe to work in
steps_then_go_on.says: The assessment notes it. A cleanup company may be needed first (no company named).
Staff never handle or give medicine. The family packs them in a labeled bag that travels with the older adult.
Staff never touch them. The family removes them before sorting.

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about money, medicines, or what a doctor or a lawyer should decide go to the business's own line

pf.first_steps.before_agreement: The in-home assessment with the older adult and the family; a written plan and estimate within 3 business days

after_agreement.name: Signed agreement
after_agreement.who: the older adult when they can decide, or their agent or guardian; and the person who pays
after_agreement.result: the rate, the estimate range, the sessions, who decides about belongings, the weekly bill, the retainer, the cancel terms

after_agreement.name: Floor plan of the new home
after_agreement.who: the business, from the new home's plan or a measuring visit
after_agreement.result: what furniture fits; the rest is sorted

after_agreement.name: Moving company booked
after_agreement.when: at least 3 weeks before move day
after_agreement.who: the family hires it; the business helps choose and confirms the date
after_agreement.result: the mover's date and arrival window

after_agreement.name: The new home's move-in OK
after_agreement.who: the family; the business sends its insurance certificate if asked
after_agreement.result: the move-in date, the elevator and the hours

pf.first_steps.prep: Before the assessment: have whoever decides there or on the phone, and don't throw things away yet. Before sorting: set aside papers, medicines and valuables. Before move day: pack a bag with medicines, glasses, hearing aids and chargers that travels with the older adult.
pf.first_steps.planning_prep: Before a planning call: the new home's floor plan or its size, and the move-in date, if known

pf.visit.check_in: The check-in code from whoever meets the lead at the door (the older adult or a family member). An older adult without a mobile: the family member gets the code, or the lead texts DONE at the end. Unpacking with nobody home: a start photo and DONE with photos. Planning calls: the code is said at the start of the call.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The lead meets the older adult, walks the home, measures key furniture, and sends a written plan and estimate on the secure page within 3 business days
pf.visit.changes: Hours over the estimate's top need the payer's yes first. Added services (an estate sale, a cleanout) go to partner businesses the family picks and pays.
pf.visit.done: Each session ends with DONE and its hours; the move ends when the new home is set up and the older adult has walked through it
pf.visit.items: Each item's fate (move, family, donate, sell, discard) is decided by the older adult or the named decision maker, never by staff; donation receipts go to the family with the last bill
pf.visit.found_items: Cash, jewelry, papers and keepsakes found while sorting are shown to the older adult or the named decision maker, logged with a photo, and never thrown away or taken by staff
pf.visit.nobody_answers: Nobody answers the door at a session: the lead calls the older adult, then the family contact, before anything else; no fee words until they are found safe

pf.money.assessment: free; nothing taken and nothing owed
pf.money.hourly: Per hour per person, billed weekly (every Friday) for the hours worked, each session's times listed
pf.money.retainer: A $500 retainer when the agreement is signed (example), taken off the last bill; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.over_estimate: Hours past the estimate's top need the payer's yes first
pf.money.who_pays: The older adult, a family member or an agent under a power of attorney; the bill goes to whoever the agreement names
pf.money.movers: The moving company bills the family its own way; the business takes no fee on it and no referral fee unless it tells the family in writing
pf.money.cancel: A session cancelled less than 48 hours ahead may be billed 1 hour ($85, example), only if the owner confirms; never for a hospital stay or a death
pf.money.remote_plan: The $150 remote move plan is paid in full when booked; a late cancel may keep $20 of it, only with the owner's yes (example)
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: one per confirmed booking; a whole move from one agreement is one job, so one $2
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe for weekly bills over the owner's amount; paid once it clears. A check from an agent under a power of attorney also works: the lead texts 'paid check'.

never_in_texts: Health, memory or care details, and money details
Why someone is moving: owner and staff texts never say it
Contract papers and lab or medical papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.older_adult: Texts go to the older adult only if they have a mobile and said yes; otherwise reminders go to the family contact, or by phone call where the older adult asked for calls
pf.messages.tone: Plain and patient; no rushing; the older adult is spoken to directly, never about as if absent

pf.staff.roles: Move leads (Marta, Joel) run each move; move assistants help on packing and move days. Planners (Joan, Priya) take the planning calls and the remote plans.
pf.staff.licenses: No person license; a background check for everyone in clients' homes
pf.staff.who_oks: The owner OKs every agreement and any estimate change
pf.staff.stand_in: The older adult keeps the same lead wherever possible; a new person is offered only with the older adult's or the family's OK first, never on silence
pf.staff.two_people: Packing and move days need two people; sorting sessions can be one
pf.staff.never: Staff never accept gifts or buy items from a client, never handle money or medicines, and never sign anything for the client

pf.rules.agreement: A written agreement before the first session, with the rate, the estimate range and the cancel terms; a written cancel period where the state's rules give one
pf.rules.decisions: The older adult decides about their belongings whenever they can. When they can't, the person named in the agreement decides.
pf.rules.authority: A power of attorney ends when the person dies; from then on, only the executor may decide about the belongings
pf.rules.partners: Estate sale, donation, cleanout and moving companies are separate businesses the family picks and pays

pf.edges.move_date_fixed: A move-in date the community set can't move: the family decides, and no new person comes without their OK
pf.edges.hospital_stay: Sessions pause with no fee while the older adult is in the hospital or rehab
pf.edges.death_during_move: Every text to the older adult stops; sessions pause; the work goes on only once the executor confirms
pf.edges.older_adult_changes_mind: The session stops and the people the older adult named are told; nothing is packed or thrown away against the older adult's wishes
pf.edges.family_disagrees: Work on the disputed items waits for the named decision maker
pf.edges.nobody_answers: Nobody answers the door at a session: the lead calls the older adult, then the family contact, before anything else; a fee is never asked until they're found safe
pf.edges.landline_only: An older adult with only a landline gets reminder calls, or reminders go to the family contact
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
New profession (P3 pass, Tue Oct 27 2026, batch P6), started from the refitted movers (from: movers), merged with the verified Oct 24 test-drive plug-in (work/testdrive/senior-move.md, 12 findings, all general). The movers' truck, weigh-ticket and bill-of-lading move-day chain, vault storage and crate prices were not carried; every pf key, rename pair and own step was rewritten for a senior move manager.
Style Project: a free in-home assessment, a written plan and estimate, a signed agreement with a retainer, a cancel window, then sessions over weeks (sorting, packing, move day, unpacking) billed by the hour every Friday. The moving company is a separate business the family hires and pays; the business books and supervises the date and takes no fee on it.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: Alex (the older adult, with their daughter on the phone) at 48 Linden Ave moving to 300 Maple Ct. Free assessment Thu Oct 22, 9am (set start, Marta); the plan and estimate Fri Oct 23 after Sam's OK: about 50 person-hours at $85 = $4,250 (sorting and packing about 34 hours $2,890 + move day and unpacking about 16 hours $1,360); the range is 40 to 60 person-hours ($3,400 to $5,100). Agreement Mon Oct 26 (Alex) and Tue Oct 27 (Sam); $500 retainer Tue Oct 27 (taken off the last bill; the cap comes from the state's form); cancel window to 11:59pm Mon Nov 2 (switch cancelright, flow B only). Sessions Tue Nov 3 to Tue Dec 8; weekly bills $680, $680, $680, $510, $850 and a last bill of $350 (week 6 $850 less the $500 retainer): 50 hours, $4,250 in all, the receipt adds up.
Hours past the top of the range need the payer's own yes first (master B9-22 line); a session cancelled less than 48 hours ahead may be billed 1 hour ($85, example) only if the owner confirms, never for a hospital stay or a death. The assessment and the family planning call are free, so a no costs nothing.
Flow B money paths: visit|none|bill (main), visit|none|own (an agent's check under a power of attorney; Rosie sends nothing about money), list|none|bill (a downsizing session, $85 an hour, 3-hour minimum = $255, billed after). Other list services in pf.services (home setup visit $170, floor plan visit $275, room plan from photos) have no path of their own: they are priced and billed the same way as the downsizing session.
Flow A is Sam's second company Lee Move Planning (remote planning by phone or video, no walk-ins; planners Joan and Priya). Paths: list|none|none (main: a free 30-minute family planning call) and list|full|none (the $150 remote move plan, paid in full; a late cancel may keep $20 of it, only with the owner's yes). A8-x01 offers the free in-home assessment, which runs in flow B. Cards name 'a planning session' on every A path (the master hard-codes one service name per flow, MASTER line in the log).
Own steps (dated forward): B8-x01 Tue Nov 3 floor plan + the family books the moving company 3 weeks ahead (nothing named that is private); B8-x02 (a branch of B8-22) Thu Nov 12 Alex changes their mind: the session stops, nothing is packed or thrown away against their wishes, the people they named are told only that it stopped. The work plan B8-37 (Tue Nov 3), the weekly bill B9-22 (Fri Dec 11), the receipt B10-01 and the rating B10-02 are the master's steps with this work's words.
Safety: stop = a fall and can't get up, sudden confusion, chest pain or trouble breathing; a fire, smoke or gas smell. Steps then go on = dementia or confusion that comes and goes (the same lead each time, short sessions, a family member on call), pressure or money taken from the older adult (hotline; the owner told privately the same day), oxygen and fall risks, hoarding or a home not safe to work in (a cleanup company first, none named), medicines (staff never handle them), firearms (staff never touch them). B3-11 and B3-18 are one Spanish conversation about confusion that comes and goes: booking goes on.
Who may book and decide: an adult; the older adult agrees to the move whenever they can; family may book and pay; where they can't decide, an agent under a power of attorney or a guardian signs; never a move the older adult says they don't want. A named lead is never replaced on silence. Never in texts: health, memory, care or money details, door codes, why someone is moving. Texts go to the older adult only with a mobile and a yes, else to the family contact or by phone call.
Switches: cancelright (B), welfare (B: nobody answers the door = a safety check before any no-show words). Not set: sensitive, standin, fixeddate. Settings: set start times in both flows; cutoff 24 hours (A) and 2 days (B). Facts: firststeps, documents, multiday, extrawork, photos, video, monthlybill.
Splits: S1-60 kept both (no license in most places; a mover's license only where the business carries goods itself), S1-62 the $2 applies, S2-28 no person license, S2-30 never sent now, B4-83 set start only, B8-67 an adult must be there, B10-32 a rating is asked, A4-66 a person's time, A8-02 nothing required.
The old test-drive gaps are all closed by the REDESIGN 2 master (see the log): S13-31 three roles, S13-19 contact, S13-56 nobody moves on silence, B3-31 harm to an older adult, B4-77 two addresses, B7-73 a death, B8-80 a stop partway, B9-22 hours against the range, the free path. Example license numbers use EX-2210 style. keep: moving, Moving, estate, leak, house call.
